annotationRationale: The method counts student-class enrollments by class and by each student's number of classes, tracking the contribution of each group.
sourceMethod: Uses the first official solution, with variables for exactly one, two, and three classes and subtraction of the resulting counting equations.

review.mathCheck: There are 32−20=12 enrollments beyond each student's first class. These comprise nine second enrollments and one third enrollment per triple-class student, so z=12−9=3, choice C. The resulting groups are 11, 6, and 3 students.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of official solution 13's first approach on page 4: partition students by class count, count enrollments with multiplicities, then subtract the two student totals.
review.annotationCheck: The sole assessed node, math:double-counting, precisely captures the incidence count and multiplicities. Elementary equation subtraction is background; no material node is missing.
